capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2024 (the page read); model years compared 2023 to 2024, nothing shows a change. BMW release (M70): "the battery provides 101.7 kWh of usable energy"; InsideEVs US xDrive60 same; eDrive50/M70 share the pack. 2023-2026 compared: no change named.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: ArenaEV i7 page: 376 V nominal, "400V type" (BMW i7 pages do not state voltage).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2024 (the page read); model years compared 2023 to 2024, nothing shows a change. BMW release: DC up to 195 kW (InsideEVs: same as the iX).

ac_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs (US): AC up to 11 kW from a 48 A station (ArenaEV 11 kW). BMW global M70 release says 22 kW as standard (Europe).
